settings.heading: What people say about Dear Paws

settings.question: What is inside the Dear Paws Advent Calendar?
settings.answer: 24 numbered doors, each hiding a different surprise: plush toys, rope and rubber chews, squeakers and natural treats. No two days are the same.

settings.question: Is it suitable for all dog breeds and sizes?
settings.answer: Yes. Toys are sized to be safe for small breeds and durable enough for large ones. Always supervise your dog with new toys.

settings.question: When should I order to receive it before December 1st?
settings.answer: Orders placed before November 20th typically arrive in time for the first door. We ship from Canada with tracking on every order.

settings.question: Does it come ready to gift?
settings.answer: It does. The calendar arrives in a forest green and gold gift box with no prices shown, so it can go straight under the tree.

settings.question: Are the toys safe for my dog?
settings.answer: All toys use vet-approved materials and the treats are made with natural ingredients. Check the ingredient list on each pack if your dog has allergies.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: If you or your pup are not happy within 30 days, contact us and we will make it right with a replacement or a full refund.

settings.question: Do you offer free shipping?
settings.answer: Yes, shipping is free on every order. Add shipping protection at checkout to cover loss or damage in transit.
